name: Spell Siege
summary:
# The Kingdom of Souspire is under attack - and only you can defend it.

Spell Siege is a single-player Wave Defense Game. Wield your magic wand to cast gesture-based spells, survive hordes of enemies, and defeat the evil dragons - with a savvy wizard fox named Enzo guiding you along the way.

**Master elemental magic under the guidance of Enzo the Brilliant.**  
Learn to cast powerful spells and prepare the battles to come.
